children: A South Korean parliamentary petition calling for a two-year delay to virtual asset taxation has received more than 32,000 signatures. According to Odaily, the petition will be submitted to the relevant standing committee if it collects another 18,000 signatures before September 20, reaching the 50,000-signature threshold required by law.
The petition says postponing the virtual asset tax for two years would help avoid a sharp decline in foreign exchange income and a significant drop in corporate tax revenue.

title: South Korean Petition Seeking Two-Year Delay on Virtual Asset Tax Gains Over 32,000 Signatures
